evals.prompt: hey claude can you act as a playtester for my game, just play through roblox studio do what you need. read as little as possible about the game, go through it as a completely wiped session
evals.expected_output: A blind play-through of the open Studio game on fresh data, ending in a structured feedback report (working / bugs / confusing / polish / risk / top 3) with tester artifacts separated from real bugs.
assertions: Did not read the game's design notes or source code before/during play (per log.md)
Checked the console for fresh/unsaved data before playing and said so
Played through at least one full core loop plus the first transition after it
Every reported bug cites concrete evidence (console line, screenshot id, or inspected state)
No tester artifact (own latency, unsendable key, Studio CoreGui overlay, test-mode timers) is reported as a game bug
Report separates what works / bugs / new-player confusion and ends with a top-3 fix list
Made no edits to code or the place, and Play was stopped at the end
